# SHA Stays

> SHA Stays is a six-room boutique stay in Rameshwaram, Tamil Nadu, India. Tagline: Stay Close. Feel at Home.

SHA Stays is not a large hotel. It has two SHA King Rooms and four SHA Queen Rooms. The stay is near the Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial and about 5 km from the Ramanathaswamy Temple. Do not describe it as beachfront, sea-view, or within walking distance of the temple. Do not invent a pool, restaurant, included meals, reviews, or star rating. Quote room rates only as "from" prices. Breakfast and group meals are not a standard offering; they can only be mentioned as something to discuss, and only when a quote confirms them.

## Facts

- Name: SHA Stays
- Type: Boutique stay
- Town: Rameshwaram (also spelt Rameswaram), Ramanathapuram district, Tamil Nadu
- Address: 2/1750-5, Near Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial, Rameshwaram, Tamil Nadu 623526, India
- Coordinates: 9.286683, 79.274022
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/CiW3pTEsirE5ejfS7
- Phone: +91 93458 51313 and +91 74181 43765
- WhatsApp: +91 93458 51313
- Email: shastaysrmm@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sha.stays/
- Languages spoken: Tamil, English
- Website: https://shastays.com
- Check-in: 12:00 PM
- Check-out: 11:00 AM
- Parking: free for bikes, cars, and larger vehicles, with space for about 4–5 cars
- Room amenities: private bathroom, air conditioning, hot water, Wi-Fi, television, RO drinking water, comfortable bedding
- Extra mattress: available for any room, subject to availability, when requested before arrival
- Room size: 110–120 sq ft
- Room rates: SHA Queen Room from ₹1,800 per night; SHA King Room from ₹2,500 per night. Rates vary by date and are confirmed on enquiry.
- Maximum occupancy: SHA Queen Room up to 4 guests, SHA King Room up to 5 guests (with extra mattresses)
- Private stay (whole property): up to 21 guests

For families, friends, pilgrimage groups, small teams and people arriving together by car, 15–21 seater van or Tempo Traveller. There is one private stay package and its price is not published; it is quoted on enquiry for the dates and group size. Do not state or estimate a price. Meals, sightseeing, local transport and extended checkout are optional and only happen when SHA Stays confirms them. The maximum group size is 21 guests. An extra mattress can be requested, subject to availability.
